fields.description: A discount changes this member's invoice, never the plan's price. It always has an end date or a rule — pick one.
fields.label: Discount

fields.description: Give this member one of the gym's running offers. It fills in the discount below; clearing it takes that discount back off. Editing or ending the offer later never re-prices a member already on it.
fields.label: Offer

fields.description: Blank = no discount. 'Percentage' takes a % off this member's price; 'Amount' takes a flat figure off.
fields.label: Discount

fields.description: The % (e.g. 10) or the amount (e.g. 500). Applied to the invoice's net total, so GST is charged on the discounted value.
fields.label: Discount Value

fields.description: Every discount has an explicit end. 'First invoice only' is the joining offer; 'Every invoice' is a negotiated lifetime rate; 'Until a date' expires on its own.
fields.label: Discount Applies
fields.options:
First invoice only
Every invoice
Until a date

fields.description: Invoices raised on or before this date carry the discount; later ones bill at the full rate.
